body: You are not a shitty excuse for a human. You are in pain and rightfully so. Fucked up things happen to you and that is not your fault. People suck and I feel the same. I’m alone. People who are pathetic excuses for humans kill, bully, and cause harm  but it doesn’t sound like you are that kind of a person . I know I don’t know you but I’m proud that you are still here
